age_missing: finite age >0 and <=120; otherwise train valid median; all-missing train fallback 17.0 years, recorded
reference_empty_class: exclude unsupported queries from auxiliary CE; graph-compatible zero if none; no teacher from heldout or own subfold
site_halves: whole sites assigned greedily to balance per-class counts in each reference subfold; fixed private SHA256 RNG tie-breaks; no site crosses halves
prototype_partition: train-only greedy per-class/site round robin, private RNG; same mapping all groups
shuffle: only outer train, within-site joint-age-sex shuffled cycle; all non-singletons deranged; label blind
checkpoint_selection: strict decrease original val CE + native Graph only; native equal-loss patience reset
historical_protocol_limitations: repeated CV seeds are not independent cohorts
storage_override: User authorized /tmp due recurring /data I/O errors; historical inputs remain read-only
statistics: Single seed 911; arithmetic mean and sample SD of 10 fold metrics (ddof=1); paired fold differences; correlated CV, not independent cohorts
historical_equivalence: Original D4 source compiled read-only only as preflight oracle; no production imports from historical experiments
decision_rule: Positive (descriptive, not significance): E4 beats E1 in ACC and AUC with >=6 improved folds each, beats E5 in ACC/AUC, does not reduce SEN vs E1, and has AUC >= E2/E3; Negative if E4 does not improve either ACC or AUC vs E1; otherwise Mixed. Mechanisms and limits must also be reported.
